content: यतस् {%ind.%} [यद्-तसिल्] (often used merely for the <ab>abl.</ab> of the relative pronoun यद्) .²1 From whence (referring to persons or things), from what, from which place or quarter; यतस्त्वया ज्ञानमशेषमाप्तम् <ls>R. 5. 4</ls>. (यतः = यस्मात् from whom); यतश्च भयमाशङ्केत् प्राचीं तां कल्पयेद् दिशम् <ls>Ms. 7. 189</ls>. .²2 For which reason, wherefore, in consequence of which. .²3 As, since, for, because; उवाच चैनं परमार्थतो हरं न वेत्सि नूनं यत एवमात्थ माम् <ls>Ku. 5. 75</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 76</ls>, <ls n="R.">13. 61</ls>; <ab>oft.</ab> with ततः as correlative. .²4 From which time forward, ever since. .²5 That, so that. (यतस्ततः means .²1 from which place soever, from any quarter whatever. .²2 from any person whatever. .²3 anywhere soever, on all sides, in any direction; न विद्यमानेष्वर्थेषु नार्त्यामपि यतस्ततः <ls>Ms. 4. 15</ls>. यतो यतः .²1 from whatever place. .²2 from whomsoever, from any person whatever .²3 wherever, in whatever direction; यतो यतः षट्चरणोऽभिवर्तते <ls>Ś. 1. 23</ls>; यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम् <ls>Bg. 6. 26</ls>. यतःप्रमृति from which time forward.)
